ideas.name: Bitcoin futures expiration week
ideas.claim: Bitcoin returns were positive in 65% of weeks containing a futures expiration and averaged five times the returns of usual weeks.
ideas.quote: The only case in which an anomaly was detected was related to abnormally high returns during the week of expiration: returns during such weeks were positive in 65% of cases, and were on average 5 times higher than during usual weeks.

rules.filters: Week containing a bitcoin futures expiration

ideas.claimed_result: In 2018–2021, 31 of 48 expiration weeks had positive returns; the paper reports a Sharpe ratio of 1.05 for its weekly simulation.
